full_name: Ifeoma Fafunwa | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Arts Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow iOpenEye Ltd (Nigeria), Aspen Global Leadership Network
bio: During her fellowship, Ifeoma Fafunwa intends to write and produce a socially transformative stage play that explores and seeks solutions to the extremely homophobic environment that is Nigeria today. Utilizing theatre informed by research of current laws, cultural norms, and true stories from the Nigerian LGBT community, she is exploring the roles that women and religion have played in the systemic propagation of this culture of intolerance.
